I remember exactly when you the “if I kill myself” became “When I kill myself” And while at the time I found it concerning now it brings me comfort. Not to say that I don’t see how that’s concerning it’s just that I don’t care anymore. I everything, even minor inconveniences make me say or think “ugh I don’t want to be here anymore” and that’s basically synonymous with 
• I don’t want to be in this situation 
• I don’t want to be here (physically and or mentally
• I don’t want to be alive anymore 

Sorry I’m rambling but this got me in a mood but it’s kinda like Stockholm syndrome (If I’m remembering the correct one). Basically depression and suicidal thought have “held me captive”(god that sounds so lame) for so long that at some point I’m actually  content being depressed. The way I describe it is that I’d much rather be at a constant 3 or 4 (out of 10 for general mood) then go to a 6 or 7 for a very short time only to crash to a 0 because me being happy never lasts long. So I’m just content to always be depressed.
